exact: induction by symbiont of host MAP kinase signal transduction pathway
induction of host MAPK kinase signaling pathway
symbiont-mediated activation of host MAPK signal transduction pathway
narrow: activation by symbiont of host MAPK signal transduction pathway
stimulation by symbiont of host MAPK signal transduction pathway

definition: A process in which a symbiont subverts a MAPK signal transduction pathway in the host organism by initiating, promoting, or enhancing its activation. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: symbiont-mediated activation of host MAPK cascade
